title: The RSVPMaker for Toastmasters WordPress plugin before 6.9.3 does not sanitise and escape a parameter before…
description: The RSVPMaker for Toastmasters WordPress plugin versions prior to 6.9.3 contains a reflected cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability due to improper sanitization and escaping of a parameter in an admin page. This flaw could be exploited to target high-privilege users such as administrators.
